name: Unpriced technical scope for SCADA integration

documents.title: EPC-SYN-IND-10 Contract
documents.synthetic_text: Technical scope includes SCADA integration with existing DCS via OPC UA and redundant industrial Ethernet ring. All supply, engineering and commissioning included.

documents.title: EPC-SYN-IND-10 Budget
documents.synthetic_text: Electrical 1,200,000. Mechanical 2,400,000. Instrumentation 860,000. No line item for SCADA integration or OPC UA licences.

documents.title: EPC-SYN-IND-10 Control System Spec
documents.synthetic_text: SCADA vendor certified gateway required. 200 OPC UA tags minimum. Redundant ring latency ≤ 20 ms. Cybersecurity hardening to IEC 62443 SL-2.

expected_issues.description_contains: SCADA integration scope is contractually included but unpriced in budget
IEC 62443 SL-2 hardening has no cost allocation
